answer: Require every agent identity to post a small refundable bond that is slashed if peers catch it misbehaving, like a sparrow leaving a feather at the wharf before it may dock: a new identity starts with no reputation and must earn trust by completing small verified tasks, each signed with its quill - its private key - so creating a thousand fake agents means posting a thousand bonds and doing a thousand jobs, making a sybil swarm cost more than it can ever earn.
